meanings.en: to consist of or be made up of
meanings.exampleEn: The committee comprises seven members.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite yedi üyeden oluşur.

meanings.en: a large continuous area of land
meanings.exampleEn: Australia is the world's smallest continental landmass.
meanings.exampleTr: Avustralya dünyanın en küçük kıtasal kara kütlesidir.

meanings.en: to continue doing something
meanings.exampleEn: Please carry on with your work.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen işine devam et.

meanings.en: trouble or difficulty caused to someone
meanings.exampleEn: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikmenin neden olduğu her türlü rahatsızlık için özür dileriz.

meanings.en: a style or method of cooking
meanings.exampleEn: Italian cuisine is popular all over the world.
meanings.exampleTr: İtalyan mutfağı dünyanın her yerinde popülerdir.

meanings.en: a refrigerator or insulated box for keeping food cold
meanings.exampleEn: She kept the milk in the icebox.
meanings.exampleTr: Sütü buzdolabında sakladı.

meanings.en: in a way that is not correct or accurate
meanings.exampleEn: He spelled my name incorrectly.
meanings.exampleTr: Adımı yanlış yazdı.

meanings.en: a region located in the countryside
meanings.exampleEn: Many young people are leaving the rural area for the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok genç kırsal alanı bırakıp şehre gidiyor.

meanings.en: the number 2
meanings.exampleEn: I have two brothers.
meanings.exampleTr: İki erkek kardeşim var.

meanings.en: a body established to settle disputes or judge claims
meanings.exampleEn: The case was brought before an industrial tribunal.
meanings.exampleTr: Dava bir iş mahkemesinin önüne getirildi.

meanings.en: having a sound, rational mind
meanings.exampleEn: No sane person would drive in this storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Aklı başında hiç kimse bu fırtınada araba kullanmaz.

meanings.en: white with a slight grey or yellow tinge
meanings.exampleEn: The walls were painted an off-white color.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarlar kırık beyaz bir renge boyanmıştı.

meanings.en: having or showing creativity and inventiveness
meanings.exampleEn: She wrote an imaginative story about space travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzay yolculuğu hakkında yaratıcı bir hikaye yazdı.

meanings.en: having the ability to create new things or ideas
meanings.exampleEn: The engineer found an inventive solution to the problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendis soruna yaratıcı bir çözüm buldu.

meanings.en: lacking creativity or originality
meanings.exampleEn: The film had an unimaginative and predictable plot.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin hayal gücünden yoksun ve tahmin edilebilir bir kurgusu vardı.

meanings.en: the quality of being creative or original
meanings.exampleEn: Her inventiveness impressed the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaratıcılığı tüm ekibi etkiledi.

meanings.en: a crime or an act that causes anger or hurt
meanings.exampleEn: Driving without a license is a serious offence.
meanings.exampleTr: Ehliyetsiz araç kullanmak ciddi bir suçtur.

meanings.en: illegal or dishonest behavior
meanings.exampleEn: The investigation found no evidence of wrongdoing.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruşturma herhangi bir suç kanıtı bulamadı.

meanings.en: a mark shaped like the letter X, often used to show something is wrong
meanings.exampleEn: She put an x mark next to each wrong answer.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yanlış cevabın yanına bir çarpı işareti koydu.

meanings.en: a large disorderly crowd of people
meanings.exampleEn: An angry mob gathered outside the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli bir güruh binanın önünde toplandı.

meanings.en: a large, densely packed crowd of people
meanings.exampleEn: A throng of fans waited outside the stadium.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir hayran kalabalığı stadyumun önünde bekliyordu.

meanings.en: empty of people; abandoned
meanings.exampleEn: The streets were deserted at midnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokaklar gece yarısı ıssızdı.

meanings.en: a small crown worn by nobility
meanings.exampleEn: The duchess wore a jeweled coronet.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşes mücevherli küçük bir taç takıyordu.

meanings.en: a journey or excursion made by sea
meanings.exampleEn: We took a short sea trip along the coast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıyı boyunca kısa bir deniz yolculuğu yaptık.

meanings.en: a small room or cupboard for storing clothes or items
meanings.exampleEn: She hung her coat in the closet.
meanings.exampleTr: Paltosunu dolaba astı.

meanings.en: a magic spell or curse
meanings.exampleEn: The old woman was said to put a hex on her enemies.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı kadının düşmanlarına büyü yaptığı söylenirdi.

meanings.en: a person or thing that brings bad luck
meanings.exampleEn: Some players believe that certain numbers are a jinx.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı oyuncular belirli sayıların uğursuzluk getirdiğine inanır.

meanings.en: the activity of riding a bicycle or motorcycle
meanings.exampleEn: We went biking in the mountains last weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen hafta sonu dağlarda bisiklete bindik.

meanings.en: a heavy continuous attack or rapid succession of things
meanings.exampleEn: The minister faced a barrage of questions from reporters.
meanings.exampleTr: Bakan gazetecilerin soru yağmuruyla karşılaştı.

meanings.en: serious and immediate danger
meanings.exampleEn: The sailors were in great peril during the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Denizciler fırtına sırasında büyük tehlike içindeydi.

meanings.en: no longer living; dead
meanings.exampleEn: The deceased man's family attended the funeral.
meanings.exampleTr: Vefat eden adamın ailesi cenazeye katıldı.

meanings.en: the death of a person (a gentle term)
meanings.exampleEn: We were saddened by the passing of our old teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski öğretmenimizin vefatı bizi üzdü.

meanings.en: the end or death of something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: The company's demise was caused by poor management.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin çöküşü kötü yönetimden kaynaklandı.

meanings.en: in an extreme or strong degree
meanings.exampleEn: She stared at him intensely.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona yoğun bir şekilde baktı.

meanings.en: to a great or very deep degree
meanings.exampleEn: The news affected her profoundly.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber onu derinden etkiledi.

meanings.en: a delay; or a robbery using threat
meanings.exampleEn: What's the holdup with the project?
meanings.exampleTr: Projedeki gecikmenin sebebi nedir?

meanings.en: the act of delaying an event to a later time
meanings.exampleEn: The postponement of the match disappointed the fans.
meanings.exampleTr: Maçın ertelenmesi taraftarları hayal kırıklığına uğrattı.

meanings.en: to rely on or trust someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You can always count on me for help.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım için her zaman bana güvenebilirsin.

meanings.en: a description or representation of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Her portrayal of the queen won an award.
meanings.exampleTr: Kraliçeyi canlandırması bir ödül kazandı.

meanings.en: an unused, barren, or desolate area of land
meanings.exampleEn: The factory turned the valley into a wasteland.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika vadiyi çorak bir araziye çevirdi.

meanings.en: a fertile spot in a desert where water is found
meanings.exampleEn: The travelers rested at an oasis in the desert.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular çöldeki bir vahada dinlendi.

meanings.en: having developed industry on a wide scale
meanings.exampleEn: Industrialized countries consume more energy.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanayileşmiş ülkeler daha fazla enerji tüketir.

meanings.en: not advanced economically or industrially
meanings.exampleEn: The program aims to help underdeveloped regions.
meanings.exampleTr: Program az gelişmiş bölgelere yardım etmeyi amaçlıyor.

meanings.tr: değerli taş, mücevher; çok değerli şey
meanings.en: a precious stone or something/someone highly valued
meanings.exampleEn: This little café is a hidden gem.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu küçük kafe gizli bir hazine.

meanings.en: to die (a polite expression)
meanings.exampleEn: Her grandfather passed away last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükbabası geçen yıl vefat etti.

meanings.en: to die or be destroyed, especially in a violent way
meanings.exampleEn: Many soldiers perished in the battle.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok asker savaşta öldü.

meanings.en: without stopping or pausing
meanings.exampleEn: We took a nonstop flight to Tokyo.
meanings.exampleTr: Tokyo'ya direkt bir uçuş yaptık.

meanings.en: to disappoint or fail to support someone
meanings.exampleEn: I promised to help, and I won't let you down.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım edeceğime söz verdim ve seni yüzüstü bırakmayacağım.

meanings.en: giving fulfillment or pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: Finishing the project was a satisfying experience.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi bitirmek tatmin edici bir deneyimdi.

meanings.en: behaving dishonestly to mislead others
meanings.exampleEn: His deceitful behavior cost him many friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Hilekar davranışları ona birçok arkadaşına mal oldu.

meanings.en: not telling the truth; dishonest
meanings.exampleEn: It was untruthful of him to deny the mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatayı inkar etmesi yalancılıktı.

meanings.en: a mild dislike or aversion
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at the messy room with distaste.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağınık odaya tiksintiyle baktı.

meanings.en: a strong dislike or unwillingness
meanings.exampleEn: He has a strong aversion to spicy food.
meanings.exampleTr: Baharatlı yemeklere karşı güçlü bir tiksintisi var.

meanings.en: a feeling of fondness or enjoyment
meanings.exampleEn: She has a liking for classical music.
meanings.exampleTr: Klasik müziğe karşı bir beğenisi var.

meanings.en: feeling dizzy or faint
meanings.exampleEn: I felt lightheaded after standing up too quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok hızlı ayağa kalkınca başım döndü.

meanings.en: feeling dizzy or excited to the point of confusion
meanings.exampleEn: The height of the tower made her feel giddy.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulenin yüksekliği başını döndürdü.

meanings.en: finished or fully done
meanings.exampleEn: The completed project was handed to the manager.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamamlanmış proje müdüre teslim edildi.

meanings.en: not done or not finished; unfastened
meanings.exampleEn: He left half of the work undone.
meanings.exampleTr: İşin yarısını yapılmamış halde bıraktı.

meanings.en: twice as much; having two parts
meanings.exampleEn: The benefit of the plan is twofold.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın faydası iki yönlüdür.

meanings.tr: şehrin yukarı/dış kesimine doğru, yukarı mahalleye
meanings.en: toward or in the residential part of a city
meanings.exampleEn: They moved uptown to a quieter neighborhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha sakin bir mahalleye, şehrin yukarı kesimine taşındılar.

meanings.en: wearing clothes; dressed
meanings.exampleEn: He fell asleep fully clothed.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamamen giyinik halde uykuya daldı.

meanings.en: a very small drop of liquid
meanings.exampleEn: Droplets of rain ran down the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur damlacıkları pencereden aşağı süzüldü.

meanings.en: happening or done before the proper time
meanings.exampleEn: It would be premature to announce the results now.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçları şimdi açıklamak erken olur.

meanings.en: without any apparent effort; easily
meanings.exampleEn: She effortlessly solved the difficult puzzle.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor bulmacayı zahmetsizce çözdü.

meanings.en: education received at school
meanings.exampleEn: He had very little formal schooling.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok az resmi okul eğitimi almıştı.

meanings.en: useful and informative; providing knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: The documentary was both entertaining and instructive.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgesel hem eğlenceli hem de öğreticiydi.

meanings.en: physical or mental effort
meanings.exampleEn: He was out of breath after the exertion of climbing.
meanings.exampleTr: Tırmanmanın verdiği çabadan sonra nefesi kesilmişti.

meanings.en: in danger of harm or extinction
meanings.exampleEn: Many species are threatened by climate change.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok tür iklim değişikliği nedeniyle tehdit altında.

meanings.en: extremely large; enormous
meanings.exampleEn: They built a gigantic shopping mall in the city center.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezine devasa bir alışveriş merkezi inşa ettiler.

meanings.en: in a way that is not enough
meanings.exampleEn: The room was insufficiently heated during winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda kış boyunca yetersiz biçimde ısıtıldı.
